burst: Gains Immunity to Embarrassment for 10 sec.

caveats: ⚑ TRIGGER STAND-IN: the Embarrassment entry condition ('not in the Embarrassment state' AND 'Full Charge lasts for 0.5 sec or more') is a HELD-CHARGE player action the engine has no primitive for (it fires a charge shot as soon as it completes). Modeled as interval sec:12 on BOTH the skill1 Embarrassment block and the skill2 Embarrassment-gated Pierce buff so they co-fire. Cadence is an UNMEASURED estimate; her whole damage profile scales roughly linearly in 1/sec.

⚑ EMBARRASSMENT WINDOW LENGTH is not stated anywhere in the kit. Assumed to equal the forced slow reload it describes (~4.7 s at −50% reload speed → durationSec 5 on the skill2 Pierce Damage ▲64.7%). If the status actually persists longer (e.g. until the next full charge, or for the 40 s of the ATK buff), that Pierce buff is badly under-credited.

⚑ CLAMP APPROXIMATION: 'Reload speed is fixed at a 50% reduction for 1 reload(s)' is a stat CLAMP (engine-modeling-gaps §1b), which the schema has no primitive for. Encoded as an ADDITIVE buff reloadSpeedPct −50 for 5 s. Solo/near-solo this matches; in a comp carrying reload-speed buffs the clamp would OVERRIDE them while this additive model only offsets them (mildly over-credits shots fired).

⚑ 'Immunity to Embarrassment for 10 sec' (burst) is UNMODELED — there is no self-status-immunity primitive and the interval stand-in cannot be suppressed. Consequence: the model can fire an Embarrassment (290% + ATK ▲118.7% refresh) inside her own 10 s burst window where the real unit CANNOT. This is the single largest known over-credit in this baseline; the real kit forces the 290% procs to live outside the burst window.

hasPierce is deliberately NOT set: her Pierce is a timed 6 s per-full-charge grant (gainPierce), not whole-fight tagging. Because 6 s ≫ her charge cadence, Pierce is effectively continuous while she is firing — but it lapses across the forced slow reload, and a boolean could not express that.

The two distributed-damage lines (290% instant, 447.7%/2 s) are NOT pierce-tagged: the kit does not describe them as Pierce, so her own Pierce Damage ▲ buffs (64.7 / 117.64) are modeled as feeding only her weapon hits. If popups show the distributed hits scaling with the Pierce buffs, add pierce:true to the flatDamage and re-check the dot path.
Distributed Damage against the v1 partless single-target boss is treated as one undivided hit; no split-vs-merge modeling applied.

Damage blocks are authored with target {kind:'self'} (the caster is the damage source) rather than {kind:'enemy'}, since resolveTargets({kind:'enemy'}) returns [] in v1. If repo convention is the opposite for flatDamage/dot blocks, re-scope — the effect values are unchanged.

noFb is NOT set anywhere (default OFF): the 290% rider and the 447.7% ticks take Full Burst by TIMING. The 447.7% ticks all land inside her own post-burst 10 s window, so essentially every tick is FB-boosted — a measured noFb exemption would cut her burst damage by ~1/3.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Blind second read of the kit prose only (no override, tests, probe data, or board output consulted). Structure: (1) skill1 grants 6 s Pierce per full charge — keyed to shotFired because every trigger pull of a charge weapon IS a full charge (chargeCounter{count:1} was rejected: its per-phase effects[] indexing is unsafe with a single effect). (2) skill1's Embarrassment package (290% distributed + full-ammo dump + forced reload + −50% reload-speed clamp + ATK ▲118.7%/40 s) is one block on an interval:12 s stand-in for the held-charge trigger; its ⚑ cadence assumes the optimal play pattern of emptying the magazine (~5 shots) before holding a charge, so little ammo is wasted by 'Removes 100% of ammo' (floor is ~6 s = charge 1 s + hold 0.5 s + slowed reload 4.7 s if she triggers on a full belt). 'Forced Reload' needs no separate effect — consumeAmmo{fraction:1} empties the belt and the engine forces the reload (and fires lastBullet triggers). (3) skill2's Pierce Damage ▲64.7% is gated on Embarrassment status, so it rides the SAME interval:12 with a ⚑ 5 s window (= the slowed reload). (4) skill2's 447.7%/2 s is gated on 'Overconfident, Huh?!', a status granted by her OWN burst block → burstCast trigger (NOT fullBurstEnter, which would over-fire in multi-B3 comps), encoded as ONE dot instance per cast (durationSec 10, intervalSec 2 → 5 ticks), never as a repeating flatDamage. Its ticks are left non-crit per the default DOT_CRIT gate; the 290% instant rider is crit:true per the rider-crit rule and gets no core. The burst slot is pure self-buff (Pierce Damage ▲117.64%, ATK ▲220%, both 10 s); the Immunity-to-Embarrassment line is unmodeled and is the known over-credit vector (see caveats).

flags.reasoning: The kit trigger is a held full charge ≥0.5 s while not already Embarrassed — a player action with no engine primitive, so both the trigger and its cadence are invented. Floor is ~6.2 s (charge 1 s + hold 0.5 s + slowed reload 141f/0.5 = 4.7 s) but that dumps a full 6-round magazine every cycle; the optimal pattern fires ~5 rounds first (~6 s of SR shots) and then holds the last charge, giving ~12 s. The 40 s ATK ▲118.7% only needs one entry per 40 s, so a lazier pattern is also viable. Every 290% proc, the whole Pierce-64.7% uptime, and the reload penalty scale with this number.
flags.recipe: Count the 290% distributed popups (and the forced-reload animations) per minute in a real Milk: Blooming Bunny recording; set sec = 60/count. Cross-check against her magazine cadence: sec should ≈ (shots fired before the hold)×(shot period) + 1.5 s + slowed reload.

flags.estimate: shotFired ≈ one full charge per trigger pull
flags.reasoning: The engine has no explicit full-charge trigger; chargeCounter is a per-phase cycling counter whose effects[P] indexing is unsafe with a single effect. For an SR with chargeFrames 60 every pull is a full charge, so shotFired is behaviourally equivalent — but this rides the datamine-unreliable cadence tuple (chargeFrames 60 / reloadFrames 141 / pulls-per-sec), which sets both the Pierce refresh rate and shots-per-cycle.
flags.recipe: Frame-count her shot period and reload from footage (ammo counter transitions), then confirm the 6 s Pierce window never lapses mid-magazine; if the engine later gains a full-charge trigger, re-key this block to it.

flags.reasoning: The kit never states how long Embarrassment lasts. The status is described entirely in terms of the forced slow reload, so I assume it ends when that reload completes. If it instead runs until her next full charge, or for the 40 s of the ATK buff, the Pierce Damage ▲64.7% uptime is badly under-credited (5 s vs 40 s out of a 12 s cycle).
flags.recipe: Read the status icon duration on her portrait in footage (Embarrassment icon appear→disappear frames), or A/B the sim: set durationSec to 5 vs the full cycle length and compare her total against a recorded fight.

flags.estimate: additive −50% for 5 s ≈ one slowed reload
flags.reasoning: 'Fixed at a 50% reduction for 1 reload(s)' is a CLAMP, a primitive the schema lacks. Additive −50% matches the clamp only when no other reload-speed buff is live; with a support's reload buff the real value stays clamped while this model partially recovers, over-crediting shots. The 5 s duration assumes the engine snapshots reload duration at reload START (so the window only needs to cover the reload's beginning) and that the following reload starts >5 s later (it does at 6 rounds/12 s cycle).
flags.recipe: Measure her reload duration in a fight with and without an ally reload buff (frame-count empty→full ammo counter). If the buffed case is identical to the unbuffed case, the clamp is real and this needs the clamp primitive, not an additive buff.

flags.estimate: over-credits ≈ one 290% proc + one premature ATK refresh per burst rotation, worst case
flags.reasoning: The immunity exists to STOP her entering Embarrassment during 'Overconfident, Huh?!' — i.e. the real unit's 290% procs and Pierce-64.7% windows are pushed OUT of her burst window (where the FB major and her ATK ▲220% would inflate them). The interval stand-in has no way to suppress firing inside that window, so this baseline lands some procs at their most-buffed moment, which the real kit forbids.
flags.recipe: Once the Embarrassment cadence is footage-pinned, check whether any 290% popup ever appears inside her 10 s burst window; if none do, phase the interval block (everyN/everyNOffset, or an explicit outFb-style gate) so it never lands there, and re-grade.

flags.field: noFb on skill1[1].effects[0] and skill2[1] (both unset = FB-eligible)
flags.reasoning: Per the priors, function-damage riders take Full Burst by timing and noFb is measured-only. Worth flagging because it is load-bearing here: all 5 of the 447.7% ticks land inside her own post-burst 10 s window, so ~100% of that channel is FB-boosted — a wrong default costs/adds ~1/3 of it.
flags.recipe: Compare a 447.7% popup value inside Full Burst against one just after FB ends (same buff state) — a 1.5× ratio confirms FB applies; equal values mean noFb:true.

flags.field: skill1[1].effects[0].crit / skill2[1] (crit) and pierce tagging of both distributed channels
flags.estimate: 290% rider crit:true, no core; 447.7% dot non-crit; neither pierce-tagged
flags.reasoning: Rider-crit rule says flat riders crit at the caster's rate but get no core (no 'core strike' wording here); the DoT path is default non-crit and opt-in only where measured. Pierce tagging is left off because the kit does not call either distributed hit Pierce — but she carries 64.7 + 117.64 + a self gainPierce, so if those hits ARE pierce-tagged in game the miss is large.
flags.recipe: Read popup colours on her distributed hits (orange+icon = crit, red 'CORE HIT' = core) and check whether the 447.7% value jumps when the Pierce Damage buffs are live vs lapsed; set crit/pierce accordingly.
